firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.descriptionHtml:
Absorbs damage once.
While active enemies near you will be afflicted with Exposed
firewall.description: Absorbs damage once. While active enemies near you will be afflicted with Exposed.

cloudstrike.name: CloudStrike
cloudstrike.description: All GCDs are shortened by 20% and deal 10% extra damage when mid-air.

overclocked.name: Overclocked
overclocked.description: All GCDs are shortened by 30% and you deal 30% more damage. Cannot receive other buffs while active and cannot be refreshed until it expires.

defragged.name: Defragged
defragged.description: All GCDs are shortened by 20%. Movement speed is increased.

spoofed.name: Spoofed
spoofed.description: Become invulnerable until you use an attack.

primarybuffer.name: Primary Buffer
primarybuffer.description: Your next Primary deals 150% more damage. Wears off when you use an attack.

secondarybuffer.name: Secondary Buffer
secondarybuffer.description: Your next Secondary deals 150% more damage. Wears off when you use an attack.

specialbuffer.name: Special Buffer
specialbuffer.description: Your next Special deals 150% more damage. Wears off when you use an attack.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.descriptionHtml:
Explodes after 5s for AoE damage based on damage taken.
3 stacks of overheat turns this buff into Meltdown.
overheat.description: Explodes after 5s for AoE damage based on damage taken. 3 stacks of overheat turns this buff into Meltdown.

meltdown.name: Meltdown
meltdown.description: After 4s, deals 30% of damage taken as one hit.

datarot.name: Data Rot
datarot.description: Afflicted enemies receive damage once per second.

memoryleak.name: Memory Leak
memoryleak.description: Deals damage once per second. Damage increases over time if not refreshed.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.description: Hitting exposed enemies with abilities or loot deals additional damage. The additional damage is reduced for allies.

globalexposure.name: Global Exposure
globalexposure.description: Hitting exposed enemies with abilities or loot deals additional damage.

stackoverflow.name: Stack Overflow
stackoverflow.description: 3 seconds after the first stack is applied deals damage per stack and removes all stacks.

lagspike.name: Lag Spike
lagspike.description: Creates a clone of the entity (player, enemies, etc.) at its current location when afflicted. Upon wearing off the entity will be teleported back to that clone's location.
